n, m = map(int, input().split())

import bisect

n1 = n // 2

def get_subsequence_sums(arr, mod):
    res = set()
    def backtrack(i, cur):
        if i == len(arr):
            res.add(cur % mod)
            return
        backtrack(i + 1, cur + arr[i])
        backtrack(i + 1, cur)
    backtrack(0, 0)
    return sorted(res)

left = get_subsequence_sums(a[:n1], m)
right = get_subsequence_sums(a[n1:], m)

best = 0
for r_val in right:
    target = m - r_val
    pos = bisect.bisect_left(left, target)
    for idx in [pos - 1, pos]:
        if 0 <= idx < len(left):
            candidate = (left[idx] + r_val) % m
            if candidate > best:
                best = candidate

print(best)
